title: Rabbi Chiyya, Daughter’s Son of Rabbi Berekhyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 9:8, speaking in Rabbi Berekhyah’s name. Hyman explains that “Rabbi Yonatan said to him” refers to a reply to Rabbi Chama son of Rabbi Chanina, the speaker of the preceding statement, rather than to Rabbi Chiyya’s words.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Bereshit Rabbah 9 paragraph gives Chama bar Chanina’s statement, an intervening Chiyya/Berekhyah statement, and Yonatan’s reply. Hyman attaches the reply back to Chama’s preceding statement; Chama is its author and the reply’s addressee, not the addressee of the earlier statement.

The complete checked Bereshit Rabbah paragraph contains Chama bar Chanina’s statement, an intervening Chiyya/Berekhyah statement, and Rabbi Yonatan’s reply. Attaching the reply back to Chama is Hyman’s reading of the sequence, not a new identification or genealogical judgment.
